<!-- Source page: Akkoma -->

[Akkoma](https://akkoma.dev/) Akkoma is a lightweight ActivityPub microblogging server forked from <a href="Pleroma" class="wikilink" title="Pleroma">Pleroma</a>.

It is documented in the [NixOS manual](https://nixos.org/manual/nixos/stable/#module-services-akkoma).
